newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel mutual funds perform better in August.
newsitem.headline: Israel mutual funds perform better in August.

text.p: Israeli mutual funds' performance improved in August as a general industry index calculated by Meitav Investments and Securities rose 0.7 percent.
Since the beginning of the year the general index has fallen by 3.8 percent.
The investment firm said that half of the funds surveyed had a positive real return in August, assuming a rise of 0.6 percent in August's consumer price index (CPI).
Funds specialising in leading stocks had a positive return of 1.0 percent while funds investing in government bonds had a return of 0.3 percent in August, the report said.
Meitav said that despite the improvement in the funds' performance, August was still a difficult month because of the overall declining market.
Since the beginning of the year only 27 out of 302 funds attained real positive returns, above 8.0 percent, which is the estimated rise of the CPI since the beginning of the year.
